posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
The Vengeful Five villains had an easy-to-use team name, so they were easy to refer to.  But in discussions about the new villains, I find myself tripping over describing the "new villains you fight in a format similar to the V5 villains, but there are more of them to choose from... except you can also use them with the V5 villains too."  And calling the new group of villains the Villains [of the Multiverse] villains isn't much better.  So what's the solution?  Are they the:

1) V10 (there are ten of them, right?)

2) VV (Villains villains)

3) something else much cooler than either of the suggestions above?

TheSoundOfTrees:

I call them Teamers.I was wondering how you will implement them in the randomizer. As a new "meta villain", as the V5 ? Combined with the V5 ? Or will there be a V5 entry, a "teamer" entry AND a "V5+teamers" entry ?

I'm planning on adding them in with the V5 and treating them the same way (if the randomizer chooses a villain team as the villain, it will randomly choose which out of all the available team villains to display).

I've been trying to decide if I need to do something similar for the Sentinels, now that you can mix and match each of their character cards. I think I'm not going to do that in the randomizer. You'll either get the normal Sentinels or the Project Armory Sentinels, but not an option to mix them. There's nothing stopping anyone from mixing them on their own if they wanted to, of course.
